description: My car was hit from behind at a traffic signal. Rear bumper and boot are damaged.
reason: Accident is covered, reported in time, documents are complete.

description: I hit a divider at night. The police test showed I had been drinking.
A truck scratched my car door while parked. I forgot to report it.
reason: Reported after 45 days. The limit is 30 days.

description: My car was stolen from outside my house last night.
reason: Theft is covered, but the police report is missing. A human must check.

description: My front tyres are very old and worn. Please pay for new tyres.
reason: Normal wear and tear is an exclusion.

description: Heavy accident, full front damage. Policy was bought only 10 days ago.
reason: Covered on paper, but a very new policy with a very large claim is a fraud signal.
